title: 12 Best Dal Baati Churma in Jaipur
description: Discover the 12 best spots for authentic Dal Baati Churma in Jaipur. From traditional eateries to cultural villages, find your perfect Rajasthani culinary experience.

places.name: Shri Balaji Dal Bati Bhojanalaya
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Unlimited Dal Baati Churma Thali with gatte ki sabzi and chaas.

places.name: Ghoomar Traditional Thali Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Grand Rajasthani Thali, which includes Dal Baati Churma along with several other regional curries, sweets, and breads.

places.name: Chokhi Dhani
places.priceRange: INR 750-1500 / $9-18 per person (entry fee includes food)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The traditional Rajasthani dinner, which prominently features Dal Baati Churma, gatte ki sabzi, ker sangri, and various sweets.

places.name: Laxmi Mishtan Bhandar (LMB)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Dal Baati Churma Thali, followed by their famous Ghewar or Mawa Kachori for dessert.

places.name: Santosh Bhojnalaya
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The simple but satisfying Dal Baati Churma Thali.

places.name: Rawat Mishtan Bhandar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Dal Baati Churma Thali, and definitely grab a Pyaaz Kachori and some sweets for later.

places.name: Sharma Dal Baati
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Dal Baati Churma with a side of garlic chutney and buttermilk (chaas).

places.name: Spice Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Rajasthani Thali or a standalone order of Dal Baati Churma, perhaps paired with their famous Junglee Maas if you're not fully vegetarian.

places.name: Handi Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Dal Baati Churma, or try their Rajasthani Thali for a broader culinary tour. Their breads are also excellent.

places.name: Thali House
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Rajasthani Special Thali for a complete meal including Dal Baati Churma, multiple sabzis, and sweets.

places.name: Dal Baati Churma Point
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their classic Dal Baati Churma plate – no frills, just deliciousness.

places.name: Gajanan Dal Baati Churma
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Unlimited Dal Baati Churma Thali, usually served with accompaniments like garlic chutney and salad.
